messages.subject: Possible bug with pulsew() function
parts:
Hello,

I was trying to simulate a rectangule pulse with pulsew() function, the code is the following:

> out <- pulsew(dbefore = 0, dpulse = 0.5e-6, dafter = 101.8e-6, f = 10e6, output = "ts")

The problem is that the time series returned has a 1 at the last row.

> out[1024]
[1] 1

I can't understand this because for me silence means 0.

Is this a bug?

messages.author: 65c82d09eac308cf
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Possible bug with pulsew() function
parts:
Hello,

Could you use output="Wave" instead?

out <- pulsew(dbefore = 0, dpulse = 0.5e-6, dafter = 101.8e-6, f = 10e6, output = "Wave")

out@left[length(out@left)]

Jerome
